FILILANG 1: First quarter of First year in a three-quarter beginning sequence. Course emphasizes developing effective communication at a basic level, covering grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening in everyday situations. Filipino culture
FILILANG 2: Continuation of FILILANG 1. Second Quarter of First year in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes further developing effective communication at a basic level, covering grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening in everyday situations. Filipino culture.Prerequisite: FILILANG 1 or Placement Test
FILILANG 3: Continuation of FILILANG 2. Third Quarter of First year in a three quarter sequence. Course emphasizes further developing effective communication at a basic level, covering grammatical structures, vocabulary, and sentence patterns through speaking, reading, writing, and listening in everyday situations. Filipino culture. Prerequisite: FILILANG 2 or Placement Test. Fulfills the University Foreign Language Requirement.
FILILANG 21: Continuation of FILILANG 3. Second Year Filipino, First Quarter in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: FILILANG 3 or a placement test
FILILANG 22: Continuation of FILILANG 21. Second Year Second Quarter Filipino is the second course in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on further developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: FILILANG 21 or placement test.
FILILANG 23: Continuation of FILILANG 22. Second Year third Quarter Filipino is the third course in a three quarter sequence. The course integrates language and culture with an emphasis on further developing proficiency in oral and written discourse. Targeted functional abilities include presentational and socio-culturally appropriate language in formal and informal contexts. Prerequisite: FILILANG 22 or placement test.
FILILANG 395: Prerequisite: For Grad Students Only and Consent of Instructor
